appraisal_events.evidence: Si vous croyez que je m'amuse, moi, à rester toute seule en pénitence, ajouta-t-elle sur un ton dépité, en faisant l'enfant.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator characterizes Mme Verdurin's complaint about being left out of the men's laughter with the pointed phrase 'sur un ton dépité, en faisant l'enfant,' framing her reaction as petulant and childish.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator's description of her petulant, childlike tone mildly lowers her evaluative standing in this moment.
She casts herself as left out ('toute seule en pénitence') of the shared amusement among the men, marking a momentary self-described exclusion from the room's mirth.
